name: Shadcn Dashboard
summary: Free open-source admin dashboard template built with React, Vite, shadcn/ui, Base UI and Tailwind CSS v4.
description: A production-ready admin dashboard starter with a modern dashboard, Blog, Notes and Tickets apps, authentication pages, form layouts, data tables, a user profile and a component library. Ships in React (Vite) with a Next.js version in a sibling repo; free items are MIT.
contains: free admin dashboard template under the MIT license
React 19 + Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui and Base UI
auth pages: login, register, forgot password, OTP verification, reset, two-factor
data tables, vertical and horizontal form layouts, user profile page
charts via Recharts; rich text editor via TipTap
error and maintenance pages, dark/light mode toggle
Next.js version in a sibling repo (next-shadcn-dashboard)
